scientific_problem: How to preserve minimum useful service for resource-constrained devices when access, compute placement, fidelity, and recovery must be chosen jointly under terrestrial/NTN/backhaul disruption.
why_communications_engineering: The object is wireless service continuity under heterogeneous 6G-era access (TN/NTN, blockage, outage), not an OS or game product dissertation. CWC Wireless Connectivity / Radio Technologies and 6G Flagship SRAs are the public fit; no affiliation is claimed.
what_is_novel: A cross-layer continuity controller framed as jointly variable communication/compute/recovery choices, evaluated in a site-aware digital twin plus TN/NTN disruption sim, with explicit evidence-class discipline. Novelty is the problem formulation and instrumented stack, not a claim of new PHY or operator NTN performance.
what_is_measurable: Continuity states (target/degraded/min_useful/failed); service_continuity_utility; beam top-k and dB-vs-oracle; NTN vs terrestrial uptime/min_service/recovery_steps; seed-wise CIs on Paper II; host process timing (not sub-ms edge proof).
baselines: SpectrumX: no_adaptation / static / placement-only. ReadyGary: exhaustive/hierarchical/oracle. NTN: terrestrial_baseline / static_ntn / fallback / adaptive. 7GC: proportional-fair stub (weaker).
completable_in_simulation: RQ1 profile/scenario generation; RQ2 rule-based policy comparison under synthetic slots; RQ2 beam selection under TDL; RQ3 decision regions under configured TR 38.821-scoped assumptions; ablations and domain-shift for Paper II.

thesis_critical_or_strongly_expected_by_: at least one transfer or test-network/measurement campaign for RQ3
physical_optional_vs_thesis_critical.reason: Papers I–III can be completed as SYNTHETIC_SIM / EMULATED with one scoped measurement or 5GTN-style campaign if available; hardware shipping is product, not the dissertation object.
